g.text: GDHUB-117 — an AI checkpoint: who does what, day 1 to day 29
Critical
Author (and the team)
Platform
AI curator
No model call before payment
One check of the tasks on day 1; edits after it are the author's
No tasks, no approval: the checkpoint never runs on an empty plan
The curator advises; only the author changes the goal and the tasks
The verdict is settled by the platform's rule, not by the model alone
✉ = an email and the bell. Each is sent once, and only when something waits for the author
Day 0 — purchase
Day 1 — the plan
Sprints 1–4 — the work
Day 15 — the last change
Day 26 — three days to go
Day 29 — the verdict
writes the goal, picks the AI curator, pays

text.tspan: the goal; the game and its author; the team, roles and hours; the stage;
the last checkpoint's verdict; the project's activity in the two weeks before

g.text: first letter: a word on the goal, 3–5 suggested tasks with why
✉ letter on the page: write your tasks
writes 1–5 tasks, may change the goal
✉ 24 h and 72 h, nothing sent: a reminder
Save and send to the curator (confirm)
the goal and the tasks
the one check: advice under the goal and each task
✉ the plan was checked; approves itself on <time>
adjusts, then Approve the plan
or approves it itself 12 h after the check
✉ the plan approved itself as it stood
goal and tasks locked; the closing letter
✉ last day of a sprint, no devlog: due today
✉ each member not seen working: were you on it this sprint?
devlogs, artifacts, weekly check-ins
on days 8, 15, 22: the sprint's devlogs, media, artifacts, pulse
sprint review: what landed, what is at risk, the focus
✉ the sprint review is ready (the whole team)
each task's artifact
does it show what the task promised
✉ it does not: what is missing, while there is time
after the sprint 2 review: the tasks and what it showed
advice: keep, shorten, reword or cut — or nothing to change
✉ review + advice: adjust and Confirm the tasks by tomorrow
✉ 4 h before it closes, not confirmed: a reminder
edits the tasks, then Confirm the tasks
or closes the change itself after 24 h; the tasks stay
✉ tasks with no evidence yet, by name
the goal card, the evidence, the reviews
report and a proposed verdict
the rule settles the verdict from the evidence
✉ final review + verdict; move to the next stage if it closed
